msg: There are two groups of colours. Purple/Green and Brown/Red. Start by clicking one of the two colours in the pairs to find which one leads to a high payout of mushrooms. You are looking for anything 4 and over. If the number is 1-3 then you need to switch colours. Sometimes neither colour of a pair will result in a number greater than 3. In this situation just alternate between the two until one starts to payout the higher amount and continue as before.I found saying the colour of the highest payout out loud when it switched helped me remember which one to choose.Good Luck
